Source: Donnelly, Grace. "Google's 2017 Diversity Report Shows Progress Hiring Women, Little Changes for Minority Workers." Fortune. June 29, 2017.

DATA:
- Overall: 31% Women, 69% Men
- Technology: 20% (darker blue slice), 80% (lighter blue slice)
- Leadership: 25% (darker green slice), 75% (lighter green slice)

KEY FACTS:
- Overall Google workforce consists of 69% men and 31% women.
- In the technology sector of Google, women make up 20% while the remaining 80% are men.
- In Google leadership roles, women hold 25% and men hold 75%.
- Leadership and technology sectors show higher percentages of men compared to the overall company workforce.
